name: Miyazaki

flag.description: A yellow emblem of three slanted bars on a green field: the katakana ミ (mi).
flag.symbolism: ミ is the first sound of Miyazaki, drawn as sunlight pouring onto its green land.

hook: Miyazaki's three yellow bars on green are a katakana ミ (mi): sunshine falling on green land.
trivia: Takachiho Gorge in Miyazaki is tied to the myths of Japan's gods.
Miyazaki is known for its mangoes and its warm southern climate.
